flux.name: Extra arm
flux.desc: You grow a spare arm until the fight ends. You can hold one more thing.

flux.name: Glow
flux.desc: You shine like a lantern until the fight ends. You can't be snuck up on.

flux.name: Sticky skin
flux.desc: You can walk on walls until the fight ends.

flux.name: Balloon bones
flux.desc: You float slowly until the fight ends. You don't fall.

flux.name: Static pop
flux.desc: The first creature that touches you this fight takes 1d6 lightning.

flux.name: Gills
flux.desc: You can breathe water until the fight ends.

flux.name: Tiny wings
flux.desc: You can fly 20 ft on your turn, then you have to land.

flux.name: Echo voice
flux.desc: Your voice comes from somewhere else until the fight ends.

relics.name: Beep box
relics.desc: Once a fight, a locked old door or robot does one simple thing you ask.

relics.name: Med spray
relics.desc: Once a fight, you or a friend heal 2d6.

relics.name: Grav boots
relics.desc: Once a fight, you leap 30 ft.

relics.name: Zap torch
relics.desc: Once a fight, one target within 40 ft takes 2d8 lightning.

relics.name: Force buckle
relics.desc: Once a fight, you gain +4 Armor until the start of your next turn.

relics.name: Boom marble
relics.desc: Once a fight, throw it 30 ft. Everyone adjacent takes 2d6.

capstones.name: Twice
capstones.desc: Once a fight, use one always-on power a second time.

capstones.name: Careful relic
capstones.desc: Use your relic once with no chance it breaks.

capstones.name: Sticky flux
capstones.desc: Keep one flux power into the next fight.

origins.name: Baseline
origins.tagline: Old machines still think you're regular.
origins.trait: Robots and old doors treat you as a person from before the mess.

novice.name: Hold up
novice.desc: A person or robot that can hear you waits, unless someone hurts them.

utility.name: Old password
utility.desc: Once a fight, one old machine does a single simple thing you name.

expert.name: Rally
expert.desc: Once a fight, friends who can hear you add +2 to hit until your next turn.

crit.name: Hesitate
crit.desc: On a crit, the target skips its next attack.

origins.name: Bramble
origins.tagline: A walking thicket with opinions.
origins.trait: You don't need food if you have sun, soil, and a little water.

novice.name: Thorns
novice.desc: To hit {CONATK}. A creature you hit, or that grabs you, takes 1d6 piercing.

utility.name: Root down
utility.desc: Once a fight, you can't be pushed until your next turn, and you heal 1d6.

expert.name: Hedge wall
expert.desc: Once a fight, a wall of thorns 15 ft long blocks a path until the fight ends.

crit.name: Snag
crit.desc: On a crit, the target is stuck in place until it uses an action to pull free.

origins.name: Cinder
origins.tagline: You run a little too hot.
origins.trait: You can light a campfire by touching dry wood.

novice.name: Ember flick
novice.desc: To hit {INTATK}, range 40 ft. Damage 1d8 fire.

utility.name: Flash pan
utility.desc: Once a fight, creatures next to you take 1d8 fire and can't see you until your next turn.

expert.name: Wildfire
expert.desc: Once a fight, a 15 ft patch you can see burns for 2d8 fire. Friends can step out of it.

crit.name: Catch
crit.desc: On a crit, the target takes 1d6 fire at the start of its next turn.

origins.name: Coil
origins.tagline: All spine, no hurry, until you strike.
origins.trait: You can squeeze through a gap as wide as your head.

novice.name: Strike
novice.desc: To hit {DEXATK}. Damage 1d8 piercing, reach 10 ft.

utility.name: Wrap
utility.desc: Once a fight, a creature you hit is grabbed until it escapes or you let go.

expert.name: Shed
expert.desc: Once a fight, you slip out of a grab and move your speed without provoking.

crit.name: Constrict
crit.desc: On a crit, the target also takes 1d8 and can't move until your next turn.

origins.name: Crag
origins.tagline: A person made of hillside.
origins.trait: Your stone skin turns the first 2 damage of every hit into nothing.

novice.name: Slam
novice.desc: To hit {STRATK}. Damage 1d10 bludgeoning.

utility.name: Brace
utility.desc: Once a fight, you gain +2 Armor until the start of your next turn.

expert.name: Quake step
expert.desc: Once a fight, the ground 10 ft around you cracks. Creatures there fall prone.

crit.name: Crumble
crit.desc: On a crit, deal 1d8 extra and the target falls prone.

origins.name: Echo
origins.tagline: Your voice learned a few extra tricks.
origins.trait: You can copy a voice you have heard today.

novice.name: Shout
novice.desc: To hit {CHAATK}, range 30 ft. Damage 1d8 thunder, and the target can't hide.

utility.name: Playback
utility.desc: Once a fight, you repeat the last thing said, from anywhere within 30 ft.

expert.name: Boom word
expert.desc: Once a fight, creatures in a 15 ft cone take 2d8 thunder and are pushed 10 ft.

crit.name: Ringing
crit.desc: On a crit, the target can't hear until your next turn.

origins.name: Flicker
origins.tagline: Here, then a step to the left of here.
origins.trait: Dim light counts as darkness for you, and you can see in it.

novice.name: Sidestep
novice.desc: You teleport 10 ft to a spot you can see.

utility.name: Afterimage
utility.desc: Once a fight, attacks against you have a 50% miss chance until your next turn.

expert.name: Swap
expert.desc: Once a fight, you trade places with a friend you can see within 30 ft.

crit.name: Gone
crit.desc: On a crit, you can teleport 15 ft.

origins.name: Glimmer
origins.tagline: Feelings arrive before the words do.
origins.trait: You know when a creature you can see is scared, angry, or lying.

novice.name: Calm hand
novice.desc: A creature that can hear you stops being frightened, or won't start a fight this round.

utility.name: Shared nerve
utility.desc: Once a fight, a friend within 30 ft adds your Wisdom modifier to their next roll.

expert.name: Overwhelm
expert.desc: Once a fight, one creature within 30 ft is frightened of you until it is hit or a minute passes.

crit.name: Seen
crit.desc: On a crit, you learn what the target wants most right now.

origins.name: Hive
origins.tagline: A crowd that shares one name.
origins.trait: You are a swarm about the size of a person. You can slip under a door.

novice.name: Swarm bite
novice.desc: To hit {CONATK}. Damage 1d6, and the target can't hide from you this round.

utility.name: Scatter
utility.desc: Once a fight, you fly 20 ft and attacks against you miss unless they hit every bug.

expert.name: Cloud
expert.desc: Once a fight, a 10 ft cloud of you blocks sight until the start of your next turn.

crit.name: In the ears
crit.desc: On a crit, the target has trouble hearing and takes 1d6 at the start of its turn.

origins.name: Lumen
origins.tagline: Light does what you ask, mostly.
origins.trait: You can make your hands glow, or go dark, whenever you like.

novice.name: Beam
novice.desc: To hit {INTATK}, range 60 ft. Damage 1d8 radiant.

utility.name: Flash
utility.desc: Once a fight, creatures you choose within 15 ft can't see until your next turn.

expert.name: Hard light
expert.desc: Once a fight, you make a glowing shield or bridge that lasts until the fight ends.

crit.name: Sunspot
crit.desc: On a crit, the target is lit up and can't hide until your next turn.

origins.name: Mote
origins.tagline: Small, quick, and rarely on the ground.
origins.trait: You are tiny. You can fly 30 ft, but wind and a hard hit knock you down.

novice.name: Peck
novice.desc: To hit {DEXATK}. Damage 1d4, and you can fly out of reach after.

utility.name: Dust
utility.desc: Once a fight, a creature you can see is blinded until it spends an action wiping its eyes.

expert.name: Carry
expert.desc: Once a fight, you lift a friend your size and fly them 30 ft.

crit.name: Eyes
crit.desc: On a crit, the target is blinded until the start of your next turn.

origins.name: Nudge
origins.tagline: Things move when you look at them sternly.
origins.trait: You can lift a backpack with your mind, slowly, within 30 ft.

novice.name: Shove
novice.desc: To hit {WISATK}, range 30 ft. Damage 1d8, and you can push the target 5 ft.

utility.name: Catch
utility.desc: Once a fight, you stop a friend within 30 ft from falling, or catch a thrown weapon.

expert.name: Hurl
expert.desc: Once a fight, one creature or loose object within 30 ft is thrown 20 ft.

crit.name: Pin
crit.desc: On a crit, the target is held in place until the start of your next turn.

origins.name: Puddle
origins.tagline: You take the shape of whatever you sat on.
origins.trait: You can squeeze under doors and through grates. You don't need to breathe.

novice.name: Splash
novice.desc: To hit {CONATK}. Damage 1d6, and the target's space is slippery until your next turn.

utility.name: Engulf
utility.desc: Once a fight, a creature your size or smaller is inside you and can't see until it escapes.

expert.name: Flood
expert.desc: Once a fight, you cover a 15 ft square. Crossing it is slow and slippery.

crit.name: Soak
crit.desc: On a crit, the target drops whatever it is holding.

origins.name: Rasp
origins.tagline: Claws, a temper, and a very direct plan.
origins.trait: Your claws are always out. You climb at half speed without gear.

novice.name: Claw
novice.desc: To hit {STRATK}. Damage 1d8 slashing.

utility.name: Pounce
utility.desc: Once a fight, you leap 20 ft and your claw knocks the target prone if it hits.

expert.name: Frenzy
expert.desc: Once a fight, you claw twice this turn.

crit.name: Rend
crit.desc: On a crit, deal 1d8 extra slashing.

origins.name: Rusty
origins.tagline: A robot who woke up and kept going.
origins.trait: You don't eat, drink, or sleep. You do need a charge or a sunny hour.

novice.name: Tool hand
novice.desc: To hit {INTATK}. Damage 1d8. You also have the right tool for a simple repair.

utility.name: Patch
utility.desc: Once a fight, you or a machine you touch heals 1d8+{INTN}.

expert.name: Override
expert.desc: Once a fight, a robot you can see follows one order that doesn't harm its friends.

crit.name: Short
crit.desc: On a crit, a machine target also shuts off until your next turn.

origins.name: Spark
origins.tagline: The air around you crackles.
origins.trait: You can power a small gadget by holding it.

novice.name: Zap
novice.desc: To hit {INTATK}, range 30 ft. Damage 1d8 lightning.

utility.name: Jolt
utility.desc: Once a fight, a creature wearing metal, or a robot, takes 2d8 lightning.

expert.name: Arc
expert.desc: Once a fight, lightning jumps to 3 creatures within 15 ft of each other for 1d8 each.

crit.name: Numb
crit.desc: On a crit, the target can't take reactions until your next turn.

origins.name: Spore
origins.tagline: A mushroom who decided to walk.
origins.trait: You can ask simple questions of plants and fungus. They answer in feelings.

novice.name: Puff
novice.desc: To hit {WISATK}, range 20 ft. Damage 1d6, and the spot is lightly obscured until your next turn.

utility.name: Spores
utility.desc: Once a fight, a creature within 20 ft is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

expert.name: Bloom
expert.desc: Once a fight, friends within 10 ft heal 1d8, and enemies there take 1d8.

crit.name: Sleepy
crit.desc: On a crit, the target is drowsy and has a −2 on its next attack.

origins.name: Static
origins.tagline: You heard it from a guy who heard it from a radio.
origins.trait: Once a day you know a true rumor about the place you're standing.

novice.name: Distract
novice.desc: A creature who can hear you looks where you point, unless it is in a fight already.

utility.name: Hot tip
utility.desc: Once a fight, you or a friend adds +1d4 to one roll.

expert.name: The story
expert.desc: Once a fight, creatures who can hear you believe one harmless claim for a minute.

crit.name: Off balance
crit.desc: On a crit, the target's next attack has a −2.

origins.name: Thump
origins.tagline: Big enough to be the door.
origins.trait: You are about 8 ft tall. You count as one size larger for lifting and shoving.

novice.name: Bash
novice.desc: To hit {STRATK}. Damage 1d12 bludgeoning.

utility.name: Stomp
utility.desc: Once a fight, creatures next to you take 1d8 and fall prone.

expert.name: Hurl friend
expert.desc: Once a fight, you throw a willing friend 20 ft. The landing is safe.

crit.name: Winded
crit.desc: On a crit, the target loses its next move.

origins.name: Whisk
origins.tagline: Ears up, plans flexible.
origins.trait: You have keen ears and a climb speed of 30 ft.

novice.name: Scratch
novice.desc: To hit {DEXATK}. Damage 1d6 slashing.

utility.name: Vanish
utility.desc: Once a fight, you hide even if someone is looking, if there is any cover nearby.

expert.name: Nine lives
expert.desc: Once a fight, when you would drop to 0, you drop to 1 instead.

crit.name: Hamstring
crit.desc: On a crit, the target's speed is halved until your next turn.

origins.name: Howl
origins.tagline: The song is a weapon if you let it.
origins.trait: Friends who can hear you don't get lost while you travel together.

novice.name: Note
novice.desc: To hit {CHAATK}, range 40 ft. Damage 1d8 thunder.

utility.name: Chorus
utility.desc: Once a fight, friends who can hear you heal 1d6.

expert.name: Anthem
expert.desc: Once a fight, enemies who can hear you have a −2 to hit until your next turn.

crit.name: Reverb
crit.desc: On a crit, one other enemy within 10 ft of the target takes 1d6 thunder.
